name: Rum
description: A spirit distilled from sugarcane molasses or juice, made across the Caribbean, Latin America and beyond. Styles run from light and dry to heavy, funky and long aged.

name: White Rum
description: Clear rum, either unaged or aged briefly and charcoal filtered to remove colour. Light and dry, it is the base for the Daiquiri, Mojito and most rum highballs.

name: Gold Rum
description: Lightly aged rum with a pale amber colour, from a few years in oak or added caramel. A little richer than white rum, with soft vanilla and toffee notes.

name: Aged Rum
description: Rum matured in oak, usually ex-bourbon barrels, for several years. Expect vanilla, caramel, dried fruit and spice; used in stirred drinks, tiki blends and for sipping.

name: Dark Rum
description: Deeply coloured rum with a rich molasses and burnt sugar character, often from added caramel as much as age. Used for floats and punches.

name: Blackstrap Rum
description: A very dark, heavy style of rum coloured and flavoured to taste of blackstrap molasses, with notes of liquorice and coffee. Mostly used as a float or in small measures.

name: Overproof Rum
description: Rum bottled well above standard strength, commonly 57 to 75.5 percent. Includes white Jamaican overproofs and dark 151 styles; used in tiki drinks, floats and flaming garnishes.

name: Spiced Rum
description: Rum flavoured with spices such as vanilla, cinnamon, clove and citrus peel, and usually sweetened. Often bottled a little under 40 percent and mixed with cola or ginger beer.

name: Navy Rum
description: A dark, full-bodied blend in the style once issued to the British Royal Navy, typically built on Guyanese rum with Jamaican, Trinidadian or Barbadian rum. Often bottled at higher strength.

name: Jamaican Rum
description: Rum from Jamaica, known for pot still distillation and long fermentation that give a pungent, fruity, ester-heavy character often called funk. Central to the Mai Tai and many tiki drinks.

name: Aged Jamaican Rum
description: Jamaican rum matured in oak for several years. It keeps the ripe banana and pineapple funk of the pot still and adds orange peel, vanilla and spice from the barrel.

name: Gold Jamaican Rum
description: A lightly aged or coloured Jamaican rum, amber in colour with moderate pot still funk. A common call in classic tiki recipes alongside dark Jamaican rum.

name: Demerara Rum
description: Rum from Guyana, distilled at Diamond Distillery on heritage wooden and metal stills. Rich and dark with burnt sugar, smoke and dried fruit; a core rum in tiki drinks and navy blends.

name: Barbados Rum
description: Rum from Barbados, usually a blend of pot and column still distillates aged in ex-bourbon oak. Balanced and medium bodied with vanilla, coconut and toasted nut notes.

name: Cuban Rum
description: Light, dry, column distilled rum made in Cuba from molasses and aged in old oak, then often filtered. The style behind the Daiquiri, Mojito and El Presidente.

name: Puerto Rican Rum
description: Light bodied, column distilled rum from Puerto Rico, aged at least one year by law. Clean and dry, in the Spanish style, and widely used as a mixing rum.

name: Rhum Agricole
description: Rum distilled from fresh sugarcane juice instead of molasses, mainly in Martinique and Guadeloupe. Grassy, vegetal and dry; the base of the Ti' Punch.

name: Rhum Agricole Blanc
description: Unaged rhum agricole, rested in steel before bottling at 40 to 55 percent or more. Bright and grassy with fresh cane, citrus and pepper; the classic Ti' Punch rum.

name: Rhum Agricole Vieux
description: Rhum agricole aged at least three years in oak. The grassy cane character softens and picks up dried fruit, spice and tobacco; used for sipping and stirred drinks.

name: Cachaça
description: Brazilian spirit distilled from fresh sugarcane juice, bottled unaged or rested in oak or native woods. Grassy and fruity, and the base of the Caipirinha.

name: Clairin
description: Haitian spirit made in small village distilleries from fresh cane juice or syrup, fermented with wild yeast and pot distilled. Unaged, high strength and intensely grassy, earthy and funky.

name: Charanda
description: Sugarcane spirit from Michoacán, Mexico, with a protected designation of origin. Made from cane juice, molasses or both, it tastes grassy, fruity and slightly earthy.

name: Pineapple Rum
description: Rum infused or distilled with pineapple, in the style of the Victorian pineapple rums. Usually aged rum based and fairly dry, with roasted pineapple and clove notes.

name: Coconut Rum
description: Rum flavoured with coconut. Ranges from sweet, low strength liqueur styles around 21 percent to drier full strength bottlings at 40 percent; used in tropical drinks.

name: Arrack
description: A family of South and Southeast Asian spirits distilled from sugarcane, coconut flower sap or rice. Batavia arrack from Java and coconut arrack from Sri Lanka are the main kinds in bars.

name: Batavia Arrack
description: Indonesian spirit from Java, distilled from sugarcane molasses fermented with red rice. Funky, smoky and pungent; a traditional punch ingredient used in small amounts.

name: Bacardi Carta Blanca White Rum
